```{r message=F, warning=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(aod)
```

```{r, echo=T, results='hide', message=F}
msleep <- glimpse(msleep)
storms <- storms
lizards <- lizards
```
# __Mammals sleep dataset (msleep)__

__Q1. Use filter() to subset msleep to only animals who are awake for at least 12 hours of the day.__
```{r}
msleep %>%
  filter(awake >= 12)
```
__Q2. Use mutate() to create a new column called percent_day_awake that gives the percentage of the day that each species spends awake. Use select() with everything() at the end to verify your calculation.__
```{r}
percent_day_awake <- msleep %>% mutate(percent_day_awake = (awake / 24) * 100)
percent_day_awake %>% 
  select(everything())
```

# __Storm tracks data (storms)__
__Q3. Use group_by() and summarise() to calculate the number of storms per year.__
```{r}
storms %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    num_storms = n())

```
__Q4. Use filter() to subset storms to only storms with wind speeds greater than 50 knots, then use arrange() to sort by wind descending.__
```{r}
storms %>%
  filter(wind > 50) %>%
  arrange(desc(wind))
```
# __A Comparison of Site Preferences of Two Species of Lizard (lizards)__
__Q5.Determine which Site and Diameter combination has the highest total grahami.__
```{r}
lizards %>%
  group_by(Site, Diameter) %>%
  summarise(grahami = sum(grahami)) %>%
              arrange(desc(grahami))
```
